description: Master index of avatars cropped from the grid images in avatars-grids. One record per avatar PNG in this folder.
notes: skin_tone is a visual judgement of the illustrated skin: fair, light, tan, brown, dark. It says nothing about ethnicity.
background_color is the circle fill color of the avatar, a minor extra tag.
crop_box is [x0,y0,x1,y1] in pixels of the source grid image.
tags is a flat list for searching: profession, skin-<tone>, man/woman, hair, accessories, props, outfit, glasses, bg-<color>.
